text:
maria: Heads up — after last night's kernel-select rollout I'm seeing a clear tail spike on pool:dedicated-west-2-42. 99p token latency for /chat/generate jumped from ~210ms -> ~580ms starting ~1839460000. Dashboard: https://dash/redwood/pools/42/latency :eyes:

alex: Can you paste the token-level breakdown and the kernel selection logs? which kernel variant rolled?

maria: quick excerpt from profiler (sample trace):
```
seq_len: 128
batch_size: 3 (median)-> distribution shifted right
token_latency_ms: {init: 28, embedding: 14, attn: 120, kv_lookup: 320, softmax: 18, output: 20}
kernel_choice: optimized-attn-v2
fallback_kernel: matmul-fallback (rare)
kv_cache_hit_rate: 63% -> 89% historically, now 63%
```

sofia: Noting two orthogonal changes that amplify tail: batching heuristic now groups small requests into larger batches (median batch_size up from ~1.2 to ~2.8 for this route), and kv_cache miss ratio climbed (~12% -> ~37% on sample). More batching + more kv misses => higher per-token kv_lookup cost.

perf-bot: Alert: DedicatedPoolLatencyRegress pool:dedicated-west-2-42 99p token latency +177% (since 1839460000). Triggered rules: per-pool-99p > 300ms. See: https://alerts/redwood/alert/7782

alex: Do we have traces / request IDs to repro? I want to run microbench with the exact kernel flags. Run this locally: 
```bash
./tools/microbench --pool dedicated-west-2-42 --model redwood-base --seq 128 --batch-seed 3 --kernel optimized-attn-v2 --trace-id 0x9a3f
```

maria: sample trace id: 0x9a3f-4b7 (attached in logs). Kernel log snippet shows: 
"selected_kernel=optimized-attn-v2; reason=seq_len>64 && perf_model.predicts_win; fallback=matmul-fallback if error"
and memcopy spikes around token 35 in those traces.

infra-sre: Also seeing noisy-neighbor signature on worker i-0cfa: gpu_util avg 78% but memcpy_p90 >> baseline (7x). There's a colocated job on the node using high memcpy bursts. I've temporarily set soft isolate on that instance to reduce interference.

sofia: Proposal: add these to per-pool KPIs and dashboards asap: 
- kv_cache_miss_ratio (per-route, per-model)
- batch_size_distribution (p25/p50/p75/p95)
- per-token breakdown histogram (init/attn/kv/softmax)
- worker memcpy_p50/p90 + isolated-worker flag
Also add an alert: kv_cache_miss_ratio > 20% for >5m -> paging.

dan: Action list from thread: 
1) rollback batching heuristic change for small-sequence chat routes in pool 42 (alex)
2) add kv_cache_miss_ratio/ batch_size_distribution to per-pool dashboard + alert at 20% (sofia)
3) implement noisy-neighbor detection rule that flags single-worker memcpy_p90 spikes and triggers soft-isolate (infra-sre)
4) run targeted microbench with exact kernel flags and sample traces, compare per-token histograms (maria)
I'll create the RFC and link back.

maria: I'll start the microbench and upload the full traces to the perf bucket. RFC: https://docs/redwood/rfcs/2028-pool-headroom-kv-metrics :+1:

alex: I'll do the rollback and test. If rollback fixes 99p we can iterate on a safer batching tweak.

infra-sre: keeping the soft-isolate for 30m while we monitor. will escalate if other pools show the same pattern.

sofia: I'll add the dashboard panels and draft the alerting rule.

dan: Thanks everyone. Good catch — the interaction between batching heuristics and kv cache behavior is a classic emergent perf mode. We'll follow up in the RFC and the postmortem if needed. :white_check_mark:
